signature: SUBROUTINE ZTPQRT2( M, N, L, A, LDA, B, LDB, T, LDT, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The total number of rows of the matrix B. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix B, and the order of the triangular matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: L
params.reference: The number of rows of the upper trapezoidal part of B. $\min (M,N) \ge L \ge 0$. See Further Details.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the upper triangular N-by-N matrix A. On exit, the elements on and above the diagonal of the array contain the upper triangular matrix R.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the pentagonal M-by-N matrix B. The first M-L rows are rectangular, and the last L rows are upper trapezoidal. On exit, B contains the pentagonal matrix V. See Further Details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The N-by-N upper triangular factor T of the block reflector. See Further Details.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
